Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Performed for non-fixed deformity requiring 5° to 10° of correction (SPO) per spinal segment
Lumbar sagittal plane deformities where sagittal vertical axis (SVA) is >8cm OR pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis (PI-LL) is >15°
Larger coronal deformities where there is limited flexibility and the Cobb angle is >30°
Posterior column osteotomy is limited to a maximum of four (4) posterior column osteotomies performed in the apex of the deformity per correction surgery
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.3, CMM-609.4, CMM-609.5, CMM-609.6, CMM-609.7, or CMM-609.8)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.2: Osteotomy > Posterior Column Osteotomy (PCO) (TOC: S5.1.1)

Required findings: Performed for fixed sagittal plane deformity requiring >30° of correction (PSO)
Performed for large, fixed coronal deformities >60° that are amenable to asymmetric osteotomy
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.3, CMM-609.4, CMM-609.5, CMM-609.6, CMM-609.7, or CMM-609.8)

Non-Indications: Posterior column osteotomy (PCO) for deformities requiring less than 5° or more than 10° of correction per spinal segment
Posterior column osteotomy (PCO) for sagittal plane deformities with SVA ≤8cm and PI-LL ≤15°
Posterior column osteotomy (PCO) for coronal deformities with Cobb angle ≤30° or without limited flexibility
More than four (4) posterior column osteotomies performed in the apex of the deformity per correction surgery, except for correction of Scheuermann's kyphosis
Three-column osteotomy for sagittal plane deformities requiring ≤30° of correction
Three-column osteotomy for coronal deformities ≤60° or not amenable to asymmetric osteotomy
Osteotomy performed without meeting the criteria in the applicable procedure-specific section (e.g., CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5)
Important criteria & exceptions: There is no limit to posterior column osteotomies for correction of Scheuermann's kyphosis as this deformity is long, gradual, rounded, and amendable to more than four (4) posterior column osteotomies
Osteotomy is considered medically necessary only in addition to fusion

Criteria must be met in the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.3: Pediatric Spinal Deformity, CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression, CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion without Decompression, CMM-609.6: Adjacent Segment Disease, CMM-609.7: Following Failed Disc Arthroplasty, or CMM-609.8: Repeat Lumbar Fusion)
Documentation required: Imaging studies demonstrating the specific deformity type and magnitude (e.g., SVA, PI-LL, Cobb angle) required for the specific osteotomy type
Documentation of criteria met in the applicable procedure-specific section (e.g., CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5), which may include advanced imaging, plain x-rays, and documentation of nicotine-free status
